title: SlackToTodo
description: Extract a structured todo entry from a saved Slack message

short_description.description: 6 to 15 words describing the core todo. Shape by todo_type: Action for Haje = imperative verb phrase with Haje as implied subject; Waiting on someone else = start with first name and what they owe; Reference = plain noun phrase.

long_description.description: Neutral factual summary (max 200 words): who sent it, where it came from, what is requested, key facts, deadlines, and implied actions.

todo_type.description: Who performs the next physical act.

waiting_on_person.description: First name only when todo_type is 'Waiting on someone else'. Empty string otherwise.

claude_prompt.description: Ready-to-paste instruction for a separate Claude session to perform the required work from this message.
